name: Review-run severity pills filter the findings list
description: L02 (findings-by-severity). On PR #482's Agent runs tab, the Review runs accordion is open by default and shows a 'CRITICAL' severity pill (the seeded review has 1 CRITICAL / 1 WARNING / 1 SUGGESTION finding). Clicking it narrows the finding cards to the Stripe-secret CRITICAL finding only; clicking it again restores the full list, including the WARNING (N+1 query) finding. Counting/filtering is pure client-side grouping of already-fetched findings — no model call. The PR-list FINDINGS-column hover popover is covered by client component tests (FindingsCell.test.tsx), not here — agent-browser's deterministic command set has no hover primitive to drive it.
